en: A black‑and‑white vintage street scene showing a broad, partly unpaved avenue lined with two‑ and three‑storey houses and small shops on the left and trees on both sides. People in early 20th‑century clothing, including children and pedestrians, walk along the sidewalks, and a horse‑drawn cart is visible further down the street. In the distance, a church spire rises above the trees. The printed caption at the top reads "Senftenberg-L." and beneath it "Kaiser-Friedrich-Straße".
